bugs_found: cmd_contract_presence/cmd_contract_validate/cmd_floats_check do not catch malformed YAML or non-mapping profiles, so standalone checks can crash with tracebacks instead of returning configuration exit code 2
cmd_review_validate and cmd_contract_validate load schema files without FileNotFoundError/JSONDecodeError handling, causing uncaught exceptions if packaged schemas are missing or malformed
review-gate claims to require the latest round overall to have verdict=approve but never implements that check, so a later math-auditor request-changes round can still pass if code-reviewer approved
review-gate dedupes findings by sorted filename order rather than parsed round number, so files like round-10 can be processed before round-2 and stale acknowledgements may overwrite newer ones

contract-presence matches contracts only by contract name globally within a file, so a contract block for one function can satisfy another same-named nested/function occurrence and it does not verify proximity or binding
function_is_exempted indexes exemption fields directly; malformed exemptions in standalone use can raise KeyError instead of reporting a validation/config error
contract-presence reports only the first unsupported extension because of sorted(... )[:1], hiding other skipped sensitive file types
